messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone drop a concise snapshot of the GPTQ bake we ran across Llama / Mistral / Qwen? Need accuracy deltas + deploy profile recs for next-week infra planning.
aj: tl;dr incoming. short bullet stats and a deploy blurb each.
sam: starting with dataset/bench: MMLU (0-shot), BBH, TruthfulQA, and a small conv eval for safety. Throughput tests on A100-80GB (fp16 baseline) and T4 for cost perspective.
benchbot: auto-report: Llama-13B | FP16 baseline: MMLU 60.2 | GPTQ-4bit: 58.9 (-1.3) | GPTQ-8bit: 60.0 (-0.2) | AWQ-4bit: 58.7 (-1.5) | latency @ batch=1: 12.6ms/token (FP16) -> 8.9ms/token (GPTQ-4)
benchbot: Mistral-7B | FP16 baseline: MMLU 57.8 | GPTQ-4bit: 54.9 (-2.9) regressions on coding prompts | AWQ-4bit: 56.8 (-1.0) better stability | latency: 10.2ms/token (FP16) -> 7.1ms/token (AWQ-4)
benchbot: Qwen-7B | FP16 baseline: MMLU 59.5 | GPTQ-8bit: 59.0 (-0.5) | AWQ-int8 hybrid: 59.3 (-0.2) | dedicated per-layer clamps required; latency similar to Llama.
lucas: observations — Llama tolerates straight GPTQ-4 with tiny MMLU hit but excellent latency/cost win; Mistral is brittle under naive GPTQ-4, AWQ or per-layer tuning needed.
eva: safety/regressions — Mistral GPTQ-4 showed increases in hallucination on long-coherent convs (TruthfulQA + conv eval). flagged examples attached in buildkite artifact.
aj: deploy recommendations short:
- Llama-13B: GPTQ-4 for dedicated capacity (cost-sensitive). Can use continuous-batching=0.02s, kv_cache on, small prefetch cache.
- Mistral-7B: prefer AWQ-4 or GPTQ-8 with per-layer remap. Put on dedicated pools with SLO 15ms/token; keep fp16 fallback route for canary fails.
- Qwen-7B: GPTQ-8 / AWQ-int8 hybrid recommended; enable layer-specific clamp map from our sweep.
maria: do we have a concrete config snippet I can paste in infra ticket? need autoscale knobs + fallback.
aj: paste:
```
model_profile: {
  quant: "gptq-4",
  batch_ms: 20,
  kv_cache: true,
  fallback: ["fp16", "gptq-8"],
  preshard_kv_offload: "auto"
}
```
sam: ops notes: Mistral configs should include `per_layer_remap: true` and `regression_watchlist: safety_conv_small` for canaries.
ops-bot: warning: deploy plan that uses GPTQ-4 for Mistral will auto-block on canary failure per policy infra-ml-guard-2.
lucas: perf caveat — throughput wins are dataset dependent; real customer prompts with long code contexts show smaller token latency improvements due to KV behavior.
eva: recommendation for next steps: 1) small canary deploy Llama-13B GPTQ-4 on Dedicated (2 nodes) 2) Mistral -> AWQ-4 canary + regression eval, keep fp16 warm pool 3) Qwen -> gated rollout with layer-clamp flag.
maria: perfect. I'll create infra ticket with these recs. thanks all :tada:
aj: adding followups: attach sweep artifacts and the failing example ids to the ticket.
sam: file links: s3://redwood-bakes/gptq/3623456789/artifacts.tar.gz (contains per-prompt diffs + metrics)
maria: ok assigning to @platform-team for pool sizing. closing thread here, will ping if numbers change.
